## Session Brief

* [V1: the region ee_to_ee_nsz misses below the plateau](V1.md) - Per-channel split of the low-budget seeds against the plateau, and the CLI default budget on ≥20 seeds.

## Session Report

* [V1 report: the ee_to_ee_nsz low-budget scatter is the |η| < 2.5 edge inside the t-channel map](V1-report.md) - The under-sampled region is the last 3e-4 in cos θ below the lepton rapidity cut, where the spine t-map, bounded only by pT_min², leaves a step at the integrand's maximum; moving the map's bound to the edge removes the scatter, and the CLI default reaches the plateau on all twenty seeds.
